item.title: From SSH to git push: how I automated deployments on my homelab
item.author: Ciro Lucio Tecce
item.description:
Introduction - Why having a home server is a good idea and how to manage it

A couple of years ago I fell down the homelab rabbit hole. Like any self-respecting nerd, I couldn’t resist the temptation of building my own little server. I’ve always been fascinated by compact, quiet setups — not necessarily the most powerful, but the ones best suited to the job. After reading dozens of posts on r/homelab and watching pretty much every video of the TinyMiniMicro series, I finally took the plunge.
